headline: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia Denies Wiretapping Allegations
seoTitle: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia Denies Wiretapping Claims
metaDescription: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia threatens legal action against those alleging his involvement in a wiretapping case involving Listyo Sigit Prabowo.
aiSummaryBullets: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia officially denies allegations of involvement in a wiretapping controversy.
The minister announced intentions to issue legal subpoenas against those spreading rumors linking him to the case.
Lahadalia claims to have knowledge of the individuals spreading claims about his alleged interactions with Listyo Sigit Prabowo.
aiContextParagraph: Indonesian Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia, who also serves as the Chairman of the Golkar Party, has publicly addressed rumors suggesting his involvement in a wiretapping scandal. These allegations emerged following reports concerning Listyo Sigit Prabowo. In response to these claims, Lahadalia stated that he is prepared to issue legal subpoenas against individuals who have disseminated information accusing him of participating in or influencing the alleged wiretapping activities. The minister asserted that he himself was a target of surveillance, suggesting he is familiar with the groups responsible for these narratives. He criticized the claims as baseless and warned that he would pursue formal legal avenues to address the situation. This public denial marks a shift in the ongoing discourse regarding the security concerns surrounding government officials and political leadership in Indonesia.
whyItIsViral: The story has reached a high viral activity score of 75/100 due to rapid coverage across four major Indonesian news outlets.
